To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

deep convolutional networks trained on high-quality images can be used for multi-digit number recognition from Street View imagery and that such systems can help us extract physical street numbers from the Street View imagery worldwide in an automated and scalable manner.

we have built a deep convolutional network based approach to recognize arbitrary multi-digit numbers in Street View imagery and achieved over 96% recognition accuracy on the publicly available dataset, and over 90% on a more challenging dataset.

(1) deep convolutional neural networks are a promising technique for multi-digit number recognition from Street View imagery, (2) the accuracy of these networks increases with the depth (number of layers) of the network, (3) the best performance occurs in the deepest architecture that we trained, and (4) our approach achieves performance that is comparable to human operators.
